androidBuild.name: Android
androidBuild.desc: Installable app for Android phones & tablets (.apk)
androidBuild.intro: Packages your game as a native Android app that installs and runs on phones and tablets — taps instead of clicks, with saves stored on the device just like the desktop build.
androidBuild.item2: Saves & progress are kept on the device (no browser size limits)
androidBuild.item4: Share the .apk file directly with players
androidBuild.publishingLater: More automated publishing options are coming in a future update.
androidBuild.sideloadNotice: When you or a player installs this .apk, Android shows an "unknown apps" / Play Protect warning and asks you to allow the install. This is completely normal for any app installed outside the Google Play Store — it does NOT mean your game is unsafe. Just tap to allow it.
androidBuild.playStoreTitle: 🏪 Putting it on the Google Play Store
androidBuild.playStoreNotice: The Play Store needs extra, advanced steps that this one-click build doesn't do yet: a different file format (an Android App Bundle / .aab), a signing key that you create, own, and back up yourself, and a Google Play Console account (a one-time $25 fee). You can't convert this finished .apk into a Play Store upload — it would have to be rebuilt as an .aab with your own key (e.g. in Android Studio). One-click Play Store builds are planned for a future Flourish update.
androidBuild.desktopOnly: Android builds are only available in the desktop version of Flourish.

androidPlayStore.yourJobTitle: ⚠️ You publish this one — not Flourish
androidPlayStore.yourJobBody: Flourish builds and signs the .aab, but actually uploading it to the Google Play Store is a step you do yourself — it needs a Google Play Console account and a one-time $25 fee. When the build finishes, we'll save a step-by-step guide AND your signing key right next to the .aab so you have everything you need.
androidPlayStore.guide:
HOW TO PUBLISH YOUR GAME ON THE GOOGLE PLAY STORE
=================================================

Flourish built and signed an Android App Bundle (.aab) for you. Flourish does
NOT upload it to the Play Store — that final step is yours, and it needs a
Google Play Developer account. Here is exactly what to do.

WHAT'S IN THIS FOLDER
  - your .aab file ................. the bundle you upload to Google Play
  - ..._upload-key.keystore ........ your signing key (BACK THIS UP!)
  - ..._SIGNING_KEY_BACKUP.txt ..... the alias + password for that key

STEP 1 - Create a Google Play Developer account
  Go to https://play.google.com/console and sign up. There is a one-time
  $25 USD registration fee (you pay it only once, ever).

STEP 2 - Create your app
  In the Play Console click "Create app", enter your game's name, pick the
  app type and free/paid, and accept the declarations.

STEP 3 - Upload the .aab
  Open Release. To trial it privately first choose Testing > Internal
  testing; to go live choose Production. Create a release and upload your
  .aab file.

STEP 4 - Play App Signing (important)
  Google securely manages the key that signs your app for players. The key
  Flourish made is your "upload key" — you sign every upload with it. KEEP
  IT SAFE (see the signing-key file). If it's ever lost you can ask Google
  to reset it, but keeping it is far easier.

STEP 5 - Complete the store listing
  Add screenshots, an icon, a description, a privacy policy link, the
  content-rating questionnaire and target audience. The console walks you
  through each item.

STEP 6 - Submit for review
  Send it for review. The first review can take a few days.

UPDATES LATER
  Build a new .aab in Flourish with a HIGHER version number, signed with the
  SAME upload key, and upload it as a new release.

GOOD TO KNOW
  The "unknown sources" warning people see when installing an .apk directly
  does NOT happen for apps installed from the Play Store.

Google's official help (more detail than we can give here):
  https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer
androidPlayStore.keyReadme:
YOUR ANDROID SIGNING KEY - KEEP THIS SAFE
=========================================

This folder contains your app's UPLOAD KEY:

  Key file : {{keyFile}}
  Alias    : {{alias}}
  Password : {{password}}
  (the key password is the same as the store password)

WHY IT MATTERS
  You sign every Google Play upload with this key, and you must use this SAME
  key to publish UPDATES to your game later. If you lose it you can ask Google
  to reset your upload key (Play Console > your app > Setup > App integrity),
  but that's a hassle — just keep it.

WHAT TO DO
  - Copy this key file and this note somewhere safe: a password manager, a
    backup drive, or cloud storage.
  - Do NOT share them publicly. Anyone with the key file + password can sign
    uploads as you, so treat them like a password.

This is the same key Flourish reuses for every build on this computer, so your
.apk and .aab builds already share it.

androidGate.title: One-time Android setup
androidGate.body: Building for Android needs the Android toolchain (Java, the Android SDK and Gradle). Flourish sets this up for you automatically — but it is a one-time download of about {{size}} GB (about {{disk}} GB once unpacked).
androidGate.installerLite: We download it now instead of bundling it so Flourish’s installer stays small and fast.
androidGate.oneTime: You only do this once. Every Android build after this works offline.
